text:
Evan: FYI I uploaded the final review materials and a new Evidence Index sheet. Manager ACKs requested by Fri 08/12 EOD so we can lock forms and calendar blocks.
Priyanka: where are the files?
Evan: Drive: /drive/PeopleOps/2026_reviews/Packet_v5.pdf and /drive/PeopleOps/2026_reviews/ReviewForm_v5.docx and Evidence_Index (Google Sheet) in same folder.
Sam: new Evidence Index? what's that for?
Evan: short: a single-row per-IC spreadsheet making evidence scannable for calibration (columns: ic_name, reviewer, link_1, link_2, date_range, short_note). Helps chairs triage. Example tab is prefilled in the sheet.
Camille: updated timeline please?
Evan: review window 08/18 - 08/29; calibration 09/01 - 09/04; appeals window 09/07 - 09/11. Export for calibration chairs on 08/31 09:00 PT.
Priyanka: managers on extended leave? any change to interim reviewer rules?
Evan: yes 1 new rule: if manager will be unavailable for more than 5 business days during the review window, People Ops assigns a provisional reviewer (usually skip-level). Use the exact provisional note text in the packet.
Sam: can you paste the provisional note text here so teams use the same phrasing?
Evan: pasted from packet: "Provisional reviewer note: Original manager on approved absence; this review assembled from Evidence Index, PRs, tickets, and peer feedback collected between MM/DD and MM/DD. Recommended band: X. Sources: <links>." Copy verbatim.
Camille: what about promotions? we had confusion last cycle.
Evan: promotion context must be filed separately using Promotions_Form_2026.docx. Do not include promotion justification in the regular reviewer notes; calibration will treat promo evidence on a separate track. Packet links to SOP.
HR-bot: Reminder: ReviewForm_v5.docx is required for all regular ICs. Simplified form (ShortReview_v2.docx) for interns/contractors. Auto-reminders: 7 days, 72h, and 24h before close. :bell:
Priyanka: any change to rating labels or definitions?
Evan: labels unchanged (1-5) but added examples for scope vs impact and codified rubric for cross-functional roles on p.5-7. Please review.
Sam: late submission policy? last cycle had a few stragglers.
Evan: repo locks at 08/29 17:00 PT. Late submissions require a Late_Request form and People Ops approval. If approved before calibration start, they'll be included; otherwise evaluation slips to next window.
Camille: data export 1 what gets redacted?
Evan: export includes reviewer notes, Evidence Index rows, and recommended band. Redacted: salary, bank/account details, personal contact info, and any free-text mentions of protected characteristics or medical/health specifics.
Priyanka: can managers preview the export? sometimes wording needs cleanup.
Evan: yes 1 preview export window on 08/30. Submit preview requests to people-ops@redwood by 08/28. We'll run one preview and share redaction examples.
Sam: training for managers doing calibration?
Evan: mandatory 30-min facilitation practice for all calibration attendees on 08/26 14:00 PT. Recording will be uploaded but live attendance required for chairs and managers who will speak to more than 3 ICs.
HR-bot: People Ops will publish a daily missing-items digest at 08:00 starting 08/16 listing missing forms, missing Evidence Index rows, and missing attachments. Managers also get direct DM nudges.
Camille: office hours?
Evan: scheduled manager drop-ins 08/17 11:00-12:00 and 08/24 16:00-17:00 (Zoom link in packet).
Priyanka: small ask 1 can the Evidence Index accept links to external customer notes? we sometimes need those.
Evan: yes 1 external links allowed but mark column "external_source" and ensure any customer PII is redacted. Packet has guidance.
Sam: objections after calibration 1 timeline?
Evan: objections must be submitted within 5 business days using Objection_Form_v2.docx. People Ops will mediate with calibration chairs; final decision by Head of People.
Camille: ACK from me 1 thanks for the clear provisional text.
Priyanka: ACK. I'll block time with my managers to finish evidence.
Sam: ACK.
HR-bot: Note: misuse of Confidential flags or attempts to hide required fields will trigger follow-up from People Ops.
Evan: thanks all. Ping me in DM if you need anything else.
